infotexts.entitydescription.lotm_lavaoctopus_blood: Thick dark-red blood that still writhes slowly after leaving the body. A main ingredient of the Seer potion.
infotexts.entitydescription.lotm_starcrystal: A clear crystal holding faint starlight; it glows blue at night. A main ingredient of the Seer potion.
infotexts.entitydescription.lotm_purewater: Distilled pure water. Required by almost every potion formula.
infotexts.entitydescription.lotm_nightgrass: Juice pressed from a herb that only blooms at night. Sweet and faintly bitter.
infotexts.entitydescription.lotm_goldmint: A mint leaf veined with gold. Holding it under the tongue sharpens the mind.
infotexts.entitydescription.lotm_hemlock: Deadly poison, yet in tiny amounts it stabilizes a potion.
infotexts.entitydescription.lotm_dragonblood: Dark red powder that smells of rust and old paper.
infotexts.entitydescription.lotm_goathorn: The horn of an adult Hornacis grey goat, crystallized into translucent grey inside. A main ingredient of the Clown potion.
infotexts.entitydescription.lotm_facerose: Its petals bear faint human faces. Stare too long and they seem to smile. A main ingredient of the Clown potion.
infotexts.entitydescription.lotm_mandrake: Juice pressed from mandrake root, mildly hallucinogenic.
infotexts.entitydescription.lotm_sunflower: Petals scorched black at the edges, still warm when ground to powder.
infotexts.entitydescription.lotm_goldcloak: The whole plant looks wrapped in a golden cloak; ground into dull gold powder.
infotexts.entitydescription.lotm_misttreant_root: A root cut from a mist treant. Warm to the touch, weeping white mist from the cut. A main ingredient of the Magician potion.
infotexts.entitydescription.lotm_blackpanther_marr: A faintly glowing fluid whose reflection always lags half a beat. A main ingredient of the Magician potion.
infotexts.entitydescription.lotm_misttreant_juice: Juice pressed from mist treant root; it evaporates into a small cloud of mist on its own.
infotexts.entitydescription.lotm_watergem: Powder of a teardrop-shaped gem that always seems to be flowing.
infotexts.entitydescription.lotm_hallucinogen: Sweet, cloying oil; breathe it too long and you see colors that do not exist.
infotexts.entitydescription.lotm_char_diviner: A pathway core torn from a Seer, like solidified deep-blue mist. Can replace the main ingredients of the Seer potion.
infotexts.entitydescription.lotm_char_clown: A golden crystal that still holds a comic grin; holding it, you hear faint laughter. Can replace the main ingredients of the Clown potion.
infotexts.entitydescription.lotm_char_magician: A shard that keeps shifting color and shape; staring too long makes you dizzy. Can replace the main ingredients of the Magician potion.
infotexts.entitydescription.lotm_potion_seq9: A viscous deep-blue liquid with illusory white mist drifting on its surface, threaded with fine patterns that never separate. Acting rule: read fate for others, guide them toward good, revere fate, but never rely on divination alone.
infotexts.entitydescription.lotm_potion_seq8: A clear liquid of blended gold, yellow and red; bubbles rise but never break the surface. Acting rule: see fate, yet hide sorrow behind laughter.
infotexts.entitydescription.lotm_potion_seq7: Fireworks of red, orange, yellow and green bloom endlessly inside, with no fixed shape. Acting rule: make the audience believe what they see.
infotexts.entitydescription.lotm_divination_crysta: A Seer's tool. Using it consumes spirituality and deepens your understanding of the pathway through repeated ritual.
infotexts.entitydescription.lotm_paper_figure: A crookedly folded paper figure, said to take a lethal blow in its owner's place.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.lotm_seq9: You are a Seer. Wider spirit vision, slightly higher max health, and a faint blue tint to your skin. Never rely on divination alone.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.lotm_seq8: Greatly improved coordination: faster, deadlier in melee, tougher, and able to hold your breath longer. Acting rule: hide sorrow behind laughter.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.lotm_seq7: Physique further enhanced and damage resistance increased. Acting rule: make the audience believe what they see.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.lotm_spirituality: The fuel for spells and divination, slowly recovering on its own. Casting with no spirituality left builds madness.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.lotm_madness: Never fades on its own. Higher madness slows you down; above 70% it keeps eroding your sanity. Only acting can calm it.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.lotm_digest: Digestion progress of the current potion. Using the sequence's abilities advances it and slowly calms madness.
infotexts.entitydescription.lotm_base9: A deep-blue base brewed to the novel's proportions, still missing its main ingredients. The medical fabricator only has five input slots, so the base is brewed first.
infotexts.entitydescription.lotm_base8: A thick golden base; it only starts bubbling once the main ingredients are added.
infotexts.entitydescription.lotm_base7: A clear base that keeps refracting stray colors; smells like metal after rain.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.lotm_spiritvision: An actively opened mystical sight. Drains spirituality continuously; if it runs dry the vision is cut off and leaves a short headache.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.lotm_visionsick: The aftereffect of peering into the spirit world with no spirituality left: stinging sight and unsteady steps. Fades with rest.
infotexts.lotm.msg.losecontrol: Something pushed your mind aside. You have lost control.
infotexts.lotm.msg.potion_same: The potion is already in your blood. Another bottle will only deepen the madness.
infotexts.lotm.msg.potion_ok: The potion is accepted by your body.
infotexts.lotm.msg.potion_pain: Agony tears through your mind as you ascend...
infotexts.lotm.msg.potion_reckless: You force an ascension with almost no digestion. Your flesh screams...
infotexts.lotm.msg.no_pathway: You have not set foot on any pathway yet.
infotexts.lotm.msg.no_crystal: You need a divination crystal with you.
infotexts.lotm.msg.no_spirit_divine: Your spirituality is spent. You force fate and see only blood. (Madness +5)
infotexts.lotm.msg.divine_wrong: ...but the mist in the crystal churns; this time it may be wrong.
infotexts.lotm.msg.divine_lowdigest: (Digestion is too low; you can barely read it.)
infotexts.lotm.msg.vision_on: Spirit vision opens. The world gains a color that should not be seen... your spirituality is draining.
infotexts.lotm.msg.vision_low_spirit: Not enough spirituality to open spirit vision.
infotexts.lotm.msg.vision_collapse: Spirituality is spent; the vision is cut off. Your head is splitting.
infotexts.lotm.hud.title: Fool Pathway
infotexts.lotm.msg.paper_save: A paper figure burns to ash in your place; the killing blow is stopped. You are badly hurt.
infotexts.lotm.msg.damage_transfer: A paper figure takes part of the damage.
infotexts.lotm.msg.illusion_on: An illusion unfolds; monsters lose track of you.
infotexts.lotm.msg.cooldown: That ability is still on cooldown.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.lotm_illusion: A trick of light and shadow. Monsters ignore you for a while.
infotexts.LOTM_Pathways.JumpKey.Tooltip: Press to flame jump (requires Sequence 7 - Magician, costs 35 spirituality)
infotexts.LOTM_Pathways.IllusionKey.Tooltip: Press to cast an illusion; monsters ignore you for 8 seconds (requires Sequence 7, costs 25 spirituality)
infotexts.LOTM_Pathways.VisionKey.Tooltip: Toggle spirit vision; drains spirituality while active
